name: data-type
help: Configure predefined data type used by DLP blocking.

name.name: name
name.help: Name of table containing the data type.

pattern.name: pattern
pattern.help: Regular expression pattern string without look around.

verify.name: verify
verify.help: Regular expression pattern string used to verify the data type.

verify2.name: verify2
verify2.help: Extra regular expression pattern string used to verify the data type.

match-around.name: match-around
match-around.help: Dictionary to check whether it has a match around (Only support match-any and basic types, no repeat supported).

look-back.name: look-back
look-back.help: Number of characters required to save for verification (1 - 255, default = 1).

look-ahead.name: look-ahead
look-ahead.help: Number of characters to obtain in advance for verification (1 - 255, default = 1).

match-back.name: match-back
match-back.help: Number of characters in front for match-around (1 - 4096, default = 1).

match-ahead.name: match-ahead
match-ahead.help: Number of characters behind for match-around (1 - 4096, default = 1).

transform.name: transform
transform.help: Template to transform user input to a pattern using capture group from 'pattern'.
